inputs.official_systems: scripts/bench_cores.py::_batch with the acceptance sizes, fixed coordinate seed 11, cutoff 9.0 and torch.float32. Periodic offsets and positions are promoted from these values for the float64 run. The snapshot loads strictly into the pre-refactor source. The candidate uses the registered presnapshot parameter map.
inputs.edge_order: A CPU torch.Generator is seeded with 726. torch.randperm of the directed pair count indexes both endpoint arrays and periodic offsets together. The molecule and atom orders stay fixed.
inputs.candidate_training: scripts/check_compiled_forces.py::step, using an Inductor-delegating backend to count captured calls. Each arithmetic candidate is applied equally to eager and compiled training.

directions: Each comparison casts the same parameter and coordinate values to both precisions. The loss is the sum of squared graph energies and squared forces. A weight element passes when its absolute difference is at most 7e-4 + 1e-3 times the absolute reference. The E/F gate is 3e-4 + 3e-4 times the absolute reference. Edge-order controls permute the same directed pairs and their periodic offsets. All compute controls run on CPU.

short_block_zero_identities.assumptions: The standard embed initializes every Cartesian vector component to zero. ViSNet and FragmentLR use SiLU attention.
short_block_zero_identities.blocks.0.module.s_proj.bias: Channels 0 to 127 gate the zero incoming vector. Channels 128 to 255 multiply the live bond direction.
short_block_zero_identities.blocks.0.module.o_proj.bias: Channels 0 to 127 multiply a projection of the zero vector. Channels 128 to 255 multiply its zero vector dot product. Channels 256 to 383 contribute to the scalar residual.

local_force_fit_cancellation.layout: 5+4 atoms (seed 107) and 128 channels (initialization seed 142). Contributions are the derivatives at each affine projection output summed for the stored bias.

matched_compiler_controls_input: Default 128-channel model initialized with seed 142. Coordinates use 5+4 atoms, seed 107, density 0.12. Every candidate is compared against its own eager execution. Numeric gradients are compared with their original presence masks.

bias64.implementation: Widen only the final bias addition of each short s_proj/o_proj.

proj64.implementation: Widen the short s_proj/o_proj GEMMs and cast their outputs back to float32.

gain64.implementation: In FP64 replace (norm − min)/span times the unit direction by an equivalent gain before casting the field back to float32.

sum.implementation: Widen embedding, short and fragment scatter-add before restoring values to float32.

sumleaves.implementation: Widen all linear layers, scatter-adds, SiLU and vector normalization, then round back to float32.

first64.implementation: Widen embedding and first-block linear projections and scatter-adds.

linears.implementation: Widen every linear layer and cast the result back.

silu64.implementation: Widen just SiLU and vector normalization.

geo.implementation: Diagnostic: widen pair geometry through the neighbor and edge embed and restore its outputs before the first block; the intermediate public geometry fields change dtype.

geomembed.implementation: Per-layer rounding: widen the initial distance and radial calculations, neighbor embedding and edge embedding internally; restore each layer output dtype.

embedding.implementation: Widen neighbor and edge embedding internally, then restore each output dtype.

attnsum.implementation: Combine widened short-range attention with widened message scatters.

matched_frozen_molecule_input: The first 20-atom molecule of the official 32-molecule batch, with the original frozen checkpoint.

pre_refactor_v100_repeated_eager_fields.method: Read saved eager E/F from the original 1aa0f8b on three different V100 devices with identical weights, seeds, edge order and positions. The files contain no weight gradients.

guidance.verified_precision: Float64 parameters and coordinates preserve the published max–min normalization, cutoffs, layer shapes, parameter ordering and absent gradients. The fixed 81620f7 V100 archive passed the float64 energy, forces and 182 participating derivatives for all three acceptance systems.
guidance.fp32_status: FP32 eager/compiled force-loss weight comparisons remain outside the strict per-element tolerance. A conditional change to the model equations or to the optimizer gradient mask is unsupported by the same-source controls.

interpretation: The affected channels receive real derivatives. Large terms of opposite sign reach these channels through differentiating the forces. The wide final bias additions make little difference in matched eager/compiled comparisons.
